statement: The only true H200 SKU on Newegg's H200 search page is out of stock with no price shown.
why: Retail unavailability of a current-generation accelerator is a small, visible sign that channel supply stays absorbed by large buyers rather than reaching the open market.

impact.mechanism: An out-of-stock, unpriced listing for the current H200 NVL part indicates channel allocation is fully committed, so incremental buyers cannot source parts on the open retail market.

evidence.excerpt: status shown as 'OUT OF STOCK' / 'COMING SOON', no price displayed

confidence.basis: One retail marketplace page, no publication date and no vendor statement; retail stock status is a weak proxy for datacenter channel supply.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: magnitude 2 -> 1; sources: fool.com, newegg.com
